headline: No official business was conducted; members discussed a possible Disability Pride month flag raising and a possible missed August meeting.
summary: Not enough members were present for a quorum, so no motions were made and no votes were taken. The agenda was reviewed for information only. Members heard a recap of the Juneteenth tabling and discussed skipping the August meeting and a possible flag raising.
plain_text:
1 | Page  
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
Disability Commission Meeting Minutes 
July 9, 2026 
 
 
 
 
Attendance: 
 
 
This meeting took place at 215 Pleasant Street, City Hall, in Room 105 and included remote 
participation. Some members of the Disability Commission participated in the meeting 
remotely per the Governor’s legislation of March 28, 2025, suspending certain provisions of 
the open meeting law. A Microsoft Teams link was also provided for members of the public 
who wished to attend remotely. 
 
This meeting was also recorded through Microsoft Teams and called to order at 6:08PM. 
 
Roll Call of Committee Members 
The meeting was called to order; however, a quorum was not present. While Chuks 
was connected remotely, he was unable to participate. With only four (4) members 
present, the quorum requirement was not met; therefore, no oﬃcial business could 
be conducted.  
 
No motions were entertained, no votes were taken, and no oﬃcial actions were 
approved. The agenda was reviewed for informational purposes only. 
 
Marilyn gave a brief recap of the tabling at the Juneteenth event.  
 
Maria will reach out to Chuks about not having an August meeting since quorum may 
be diﬃcult to achieve She will also look into a possible ﬂag raising for Disability Pride 
month.

The following matters on the July 9th Agenda will be taken up at the next scheduled 
meeting of the Commission:  
 
• Approval of Meeting Minutes (Full Commission) 
o  June 2026 Meeting Minutes 
 
• Updates on the following: 
o Lions Club Collaboration update (Chuks) 
o Update on MOD Grant (Maria) 
 
• Vision 2026: T I E S H E R R R A Framework 
o Transportation and Infrastructure (Lisa) 
o Education: Marilyn 
o Social Activities and Health: Kate D. 
o Employment Activities: Maria 
o Religion: Ralph 
o Policy: Kate H.  
o Housing: Chuks 
 
• New business not known prior to the meeting:  
o Discussion about MBTA Accessibility presentation (Maria) 
o Discussion about representation on the UMA board and subcommittee 
 
Adjournment  
With no quorum present, a motion to adjourn was not required. Kate D. as Vice-Chair declared 
the meeting adjourned.
